ShortDescription.Value: Ban public street parking without tedious work. Pick per District, or use the single road button even for 1-way alleys.

Publish.LongDescription:
## 🅿️ Parking Control (PC)
Want clean curbs without changing your road design?
**New:** You can now ban parking on individual roads, 1-way alleys, with the **No Parking** road button! 🚫
- 🚗 Easy to use; prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing public street parking. - No need to add grass or wide sidewalks as workarounds.
## Choose where
- ✅**by District** - enable **Roadside Parking Ban** in the district policies panel. Manual no-parking button also works even if you have "by Districts" selected. - ✅**Manual Only** - use the "No Parking" roads button wherever you want. - ✅**Whole City** - prevent street parking city-wide. Make sure the city has enough parking storage off street.
### Manual roads 🚫
Use the **No Parking** button next to the crosswalk tool.
- **Left-click** a road to add No Parking. **Right-click** to remove it.
🚙 Parking lots and building parking stay working normally.
🗒️ Optional Status rows shows parking usage; better details than the game's info view.
## Good to know - Make sure your city has enough off-street parking. When parking is unavailable, the game may use outside-connection storage/staging as it does in vanilla. - Some vanilla roads already don't allow parking, e.g. 3-lane small roads, highways, 2-way alley. - New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. - Safe to remove anytime and designed to not impact performance.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. - Feedback and PR's are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (right side icons).
**Planned:** centralized parking-fee controls.
## Credits and Thanks
- River-mochi - mod author - yenyang - technical consultant - Dataknase, Maintyper, DragonFire - testing - StarQ - no parking icon

## How does it work - The mod uses the game’s own ParkingDisabled flag on eligible roads. - It does not narrow the road, widen the sidewalk, or add a driving lane (road looks the same). - Existing parked cars gradually relocate after parking is banned. - New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates the parking lanes (timing). - Optional: works with [Mochi's Hover Colors](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/146044/Windows) - manual road tool follows MHC's Bulldozer + Roads colors, just like normal road tools.
